meta.label: Score a dataset
meta.description: Assign a new image dataset to fitted RF-DETR + DINOv3 clustering centroids.

inputRoles.name: images_folder
inputRoles.label: Images folder
inputRoles.description: Managed folder containing JPG/JPEG/PNG images to score. Nested paths are supported.

inputRoles.name: fitted_artifact_bundle
inputRoles.label: Fitted clustering artifacts
inputRoles.description: Managed folder output from Cluster defect instances containing centroids and manifests.

outputRoles.name: scored_review_dataset
outputRoles.label: Scored review dataset
outputRoles.description: One row per input image with detections, detector scores, and fitted cluster assignments.

outputRoles.name: scoring_artifact_bundle
outputRoles.label: Scoring artifacts
outputRoles.description: Versioned scoring embeddings, manifests, failures, and provenance.

params.name: fit_run_id
params.label: Fitted run ID
params.description: Optional fitted run ID. Leave empty to score against the fitted artifact folder's LATEST.json pointer.

params.name: detection_threshold
params.label: RF-DETR detection threshold
params.description: Candidate score threshold for boxes emitted in the scored dataset.

params.name: max_detections_per_image
params.label: Maximum defects per image
params.description: Safety cap after deterministic score sorting.

params.name: force_recompute
params.label: Recompute detections and embeddings
params.description: Ignore compatible detection and embedding caches for this scoring run.
